newsitem.title: USA: CME November lumber futures up $10 limit.
newsitem.headline: CME November lumber futures up $10 limit.

text.p: CME November and January lumber futures posted limit gains of $10 per thousand board feet in late trading, with cash-connected buying triggering chart-based buy orders, traders said.
Short covering was noted as prices sped higher.
After moving lower early, traders said buying by cash dealers developed and quickly lifted futures higher. One trader said dealers appeared to be buying futures as a hedge against future price gains.
At 1224 CDT, lumber was up $10.00 to $4.50 with November up the $10.00 limit at $405.00 and January up $9.30 at $396.60.
